name: Dusk Switch
summary: A sun and moon switch that springs across and spreads the new theme in a growing circle
about: A pill switch with a sun that becomes a moon. The knob stretches, springs across with an overshoot, and its rays pull in one by one while clouds sink and stars pop out. The new theme then grows out of your click in a circle, the page settles in a stagger, and a shooting star (dark) or sun flare (light) finishes it. Drop it into any blog, portfolio or app with a dark mode.
how: Hover: the knob peeks across, the sun's rays turn and the clouds drift. Press: the knob squashes.
Click or tap, or press Enter or Space: the knob stretches, then springs across with a little overshoot.
The rays pull in one by one and the sun becomes a crescent while clouds sink and stars pop in (or the reverse).
The new theme grows out of the switch in a circle and the article settles in a soft stagger.
A shooting star crosses the page at night, or a sun flare bursts by day. It starts from the system setting or ?theme=light|dark.
